purpose: Teach: 惣菜/祇園/ビリヤード/ツバメ/炭水化物/クールビズ/高島屋/芸者

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お母さんが作る惣菜好きだろ?
lines.en: Riku — you like the side dishes your mom makes, don't you?
lines.style: Teasing lilt upward on the question. Knowing smile in the voice. Testing him gently, enjoying the moment of having caught him in something small and real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、京都修学旅行で祇園行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You went to Gion when you took that Kyoto school trip, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Casual deflection, quick and light. Turning it back on her with the ease of long familiarity. No heat, just tit-for-tat.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ビリヤード得意だろ?
lines.en: Riku — you're actually good at billiards, aren't you?
lines.style: Playful challenge underneath. Leaning into the teasing. Slight acceleration, like she's building momentum, enjoying having ammunition.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、学校でツバメの観察したろ?桜
lines.en: You were the one who did that swallow observation project at school, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Smooth counter-volley. Still light but with quiet confidence. Matching her rhythm beat for beat. A small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、炭水化物制限ダイエットしてんだろ?
lines.en: Riku — you're doing that low-carb diet thing, aren't you?
lines.style: Innocence masking mischief. Dragging out the absurdity slightly. Delighted that she's found another detail to hold over his head.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお父さん、夏はクールビズだろ?桜
lines.en: Your dad wears business casual in the summer, doesn't he, Sakura?
lines.style: Easy, matter-of-fact observation. No defensiveness. Meeting her tease with tease, unrushed. The back-and-forth is the whole point.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で高島屋行ったろ?
lines.en: Riku — your family went to Takashimaya, didn't they?
lines.style: Pushing again, gleeful now. The volley is accelerating. Her voice bright with the joy of the game.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、祇園で芸者さん見たろ?桜
lines.en: You saw a geisha in Gion, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. The answer lands. A slight pause before the name, letting her know he's been paying attention all along. Not gloating, just present.
